summary: McLaren hunts a podium sweep under Marina Bay's unforgiving night lights as Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri battle for supremacy in F1's most demanding street circuit. Alpine and Williams clash in the midfield's brutal chess match, where pit strategy and tire management separate points finishers from also-rans on Singapore's 23-lap war of attrition. A victory here tilts the championship scales decisively—the final sprint race awards double points and hands the winner a psychological sledgehammer heading into the closing rounds.
